from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re
s=Path('index.html').read_text()
class Check(HTMLParser):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.ids=[]; self.refs=[]
 def handle_starttag(self,tag,attrs):
  a=dict(attrs)
  if 'id' in a:self.ids.append(a['id'])
  if tag=='use':self.refs.append(a.get('href','')[1:])
p=Check();p.feed(s)
assert len(p.ids)==len(set(p.ids)), 'Duplicate IDs'
assert set(p.refs)<=set(p.ids), 'Missing SVG symbols'
Path('/tmp/folio-iteration3-script.js').write_text(re.search(r'<script>(.*?)</script>',s,re.S).group(1))
print('PASS: unique element IDs and valid icon references; one self-contained HTML file.')
